chapter_seo_title: Butchery — Li Huowang Faces the Ultimate Cost of Survival
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi takes over and paints a reed island red. When Li Huowang regains control, the horror of his own actions forces him to understand a dark truth. Chapter 73.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 73: The Line is Crossed
og_description: A massacre that no one survives. Li Huowang gives in to the bloodlust, and the price of his survival is his own humanity.
twitter_description: In a brutal new chapter, Li Huowang becomes the monster he feared, but the cost is a wound that won't heal.
